core: Hindbrain, cerebellar and basal ganglia development
qualifier: motor and locomotor behavior
name: Motor-circuit brain development and locomotor behavior
rationale: Members cover development of motor brain regions (cerebellum, brainstem, pons, striatum, substantia nigra) and motor behaviors (walking, proprioception, motor learning, righting reflex), which separates it from forebrain development, cranial nerve, and vocal/auditory behavior neighbours.

qualifier: IL-10/IL-12/IL-23 and IFN-gamma cytokine induction
name: C-type lectin receptor antifungal cytokine induction
rationale: Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN signaling, fungal and protozoan responses, and induction of IL-10, IL-12, IL-23, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF set it apart from IL-17/IL-18 receptor signaling and Th1 differentiation neighbours.

qualifier: clathrin-dependent, presynaptic vesicles and postsynaptic receptors
name: Clathrin-dependent synaptic vesicle and receptor endocytic recycling
rationale: Members concern clathrin coat dynamics, synaptic vesicle endocytosis/recycling and postsynaptic receptor internalization and return, unlike the neighbour centred on vesicle docking, priming and neurotransmitter release cycles.

qualifier: interleukin-1 alpha/beta processing and production
name: NLRP inflammasome and interleukin-1 alpha/beta production control
rationale: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes, IL-1 precursor processing and up/down regulation of IL-1 alpha/beta production distinguish it from neighbours focused on AIM2/caspase-4/5 pyroptosis and IL-18.

qualifier: mesodermal cell migration and fate specification
name: Gastrulation mesodermal cell migration and fate specification
rationale: Members concern germ-layer formation, mesendoderm and mesoderm migration and fate (with pericardium morphogenesis as a mesodermal derivative), unlike neighbours on primitive streak/EMT, endoderm, or heart field development.

qualifier: ribbon assembly/disassembly and COPI-mediated transport
name: Golgi ribbon organization and COPI-mediated vesicle traffic
rationale: Golgi disassembly/reassembly, ribbon formation and positioning plus COPI intra-Golgi and retrograde traffic set it apart from COPII ER-export and endosome/TGN-to-lysosome neighbours.

core: Microglial activation and neuronal excitotoxic stress
qualifier: CAMKK-AMPK signaling
name: Microglial activation with AMPK signaling in neuronal excitotoxicity
rationale: Microglial differentiation/proliferation/activation combined with NMDAR/CAMKK-driven AMPK signaling, kainate response and hippocampal neuron death distinguish it from neighbours on microglial cytotoxicity, migration and amyloid responses.

qualifier: MHC expression and TLR signaling regulation
name: Interferon-gamma signaling and MHC expression regulation
rationale: IFNG receptor signaling and its regulation, MHC class I/II biosynthesis and antigen presentation distinguish it from neighbours on IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and dendritic cell cytokine production.

qualifier: aggression, parenting and female mating
name: Aggressive, parental and female mating social behavior
rationale: All three members are innate social behaviors, unlike neighbours on stress/fear responses, exploration, or male mating and parturition.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar and acetyl-CoA transporters
name: Golgi lumen nucleotide-sugar and acetyl-CoA transporter disorders
rationale: Every member is an inherited defect of an SLC35 nucleotide-sugar or SLC33A1 acetyl-CoA Golgi transporter, unlike neighbours covering glycosyltransferase/ALG enzyme defects or normal nucleotide-sugar metabolism.

qualifier: RAB GTPase geranylgeranylation and activation
name: ER-Golgi lipid transfer and RAB GTPase activation
rationale: Non-vesicular transfer of phospholipids, glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and cholesterol between ER and Golgi together with RAB prenylation and GEF activation distinguish it from neighbours on lipid catabolism, ER-mitochondria contacts, flippases and Wnt secretion.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription and mRNA stability
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and mRNA stability
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA processing/decay and mitoribosome assembly, unlike neighbours on mitochondrial tRNA processing or translation elongation/termination.

qualifier: FGFR3 activation and PI3K/phospholipase C cascades
name: FGFR3 activation and FGFR PI3K/phospholipase C cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades across receptors plus FGFR3 ligand binding and mutant signaling, unlike neighbours centred on FRS/SHC-MAPK cascades and FGFR1/2/4 activation.

core: Neuromuscular junction assembly and cholinergic transmission
qualifier: congenital myasthenic syndromes
name: Neuromuscular junction cholinergic transmission and myasthenic syndromes
rationale: Acetylcholine release, receptor clustering, NMJ assembly with DGC/ECM proteoglycans and ALG14/GFPT1 congenital myasthenic syndromes distinguish it from neighbours on choline transport, nicotinic receptor subtypes and myogenesis.

qualifier: insulin secretion via GLP-1, acetylcholine and FFAR1
name: G protein-coupled receptor control of insulin and hormone secretion
rationale: GLP-1, muscarinic, FFAR1, glucagon-family and somatostatin receptor signaling through adenylyl cyclase regulating insulin and growth hormone secretion distinguish it from neighbours on free fatty acid, calcitonin-family and ghrelin receptors.

qualifier: CXCL12-CXCR4 in T cells, mast cells and astrocytes
name: CXCL12-CXCR4 positive chemotaxis of T and mast cells
rationale: CXCL12-CXCR4 signaling with induction of T cell, mast cell and astrocyte migration distinguishes it from neighbours on integrin homing, S1P/B cell trafficking and inhibitory monocyte chemotaxis.

core: Circadian and nuclear receptor metabolic regulation
qualifier: PGC-1alpha/PPARA control of gluconeogenesis and energy metabolism
name: Circadian clock and PGC-1alpha control of energy metabolism
rationale: BMAL1/CLOCK and ROR/REV-ERB transcription plus PGC-1alpha, PPARA, gluconeogenesis, thermogenesis and beta-cell regulation distinguish it from neighbours on core clock protein turnover, glucocorticoids and adipogenesis.

qualifier: ganglion development, neuronal migration and innervation
name: Cranial and peripheral nerve development and innervation
rationale: Cranial, olfactory, dorsal root and sympathetic ganglion/nerve development with axon outgrowth for innervation distinguish it from neighbours on hindbrain and spinal cord patterning and generic CNS axon guidance.

qualifier: chromosome condensation, CENP-A deposition and histone acetylation
name: Chromosome condensation, centromeric chromatin assembly and histone acetylation
rationale: Chromosome condensation, CENP-A nucleosome deposition and lysine acetylation set it apart from neighbours on chromatin remodeling complexes, sister chromatid cohesion and nuclear envelope/spindle mitotic events.

qualifier: DNA topology, R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink resolution
name: Replication stress response and DNA topology resolution
rationale: Fork reversal, R-loop processing, topological change, topoisomerase-poison and hydroxyurea responses and protein-DNA crosslink repair distinguish it from neighbours on telomere maintenance, ADP-ribosylation and transcription termination.

qualifier: receptor proteolytic activation and NICD-driven transcription
name: Notch receptor proteolytic activation and transcriptional signaling
rationale: Notch1-4 processing, intramembrane proteolysis, oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants and intracellular-domain transcription distinguish it from Wnt destruction-complex, Hedgehog and ERBB4 neighbours.

qualifier: endothelin signaling in neural crest migration
name: Endothelin signaling in enteric neural crest development
rationale: Endothelin receptor signaling with enteric neural crest migration and midgut development distinguishes it from neighbours on sympathoadrenal catecholamine, gastric motility and hindbrain development.

qualifier: SUMO processing/conjugation cycle and nuclear targets
name: SUMO conjugation cycle and nuclear protein SUMOylation
rationale: SUMO maturation, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of nuclear target classes distinguish it from neighbours on nuclear pore assembly, nucleocytoplasmic transport and nuclear envelope remodeling.

core: HIV reverse transcription and host restriction
qualifier: APOBEC3 cytidine deamination
name: APOBEC3 cytidine deamination restriction of HIV reverse transcription
rationale: HIV entry, uncoating and reverse transcription together with APOBEC3G C-to-U deamination and Vif antagonism distinguish it from neighbours on HIV integration, coronavirus replication and ADAR A-to-I editing.

qualifier: lipolysis, lipophagy and fatty acid uptake/oxidation control
name: Triglyceride lipolysis, lipophagy and fatty acid uptake regulation
rationale: Lipid droplet breakdown by lipase and lipophagy, PDE3B antilipolytic signaling and regulation of fatty acid import and beta-oxidation distinguish it from neighbours on triglyceride synthesis and lipid droplet formation.
